anchor:
const index = spaces().findIndex(s => s.id === w.id);
          if (index !== -1) run("space.move", { id: from, index: index + 1 });

replacement:
compact({ w }, t) {
    const shape = assignSpaceIdentities(spaces()).get(w.id)?.shape ?? "triangle";
    return h_flex()
      .id(`space-${w.id}`)
      .relative()
      .w(32)
      .h(26)
      .rounded(6)
      .justify_center()
      .items_center()
      .when(w.active, el => el.bg(t.selected))
      .when(!w.active, el => el.hover(s => s.bg(t.hover)))
      .tooltip(w.name)
      .on_click(() => run("space.select", { id: w.id }))
      .child(svg(`mods/spider-agents/space-${shape}.svg`).size(18).flex_none().text_color(w.active ? t.foreground : t.muted))
      .child(div().absolute().right(1).text_color(tone(t, w.status)).child(glyph(w.status)));
  }
